title: A NAT table
hints: `if (auto it{m_out.find(inside)}; it != m_out.end()) return it->second;` reuses a mapping (lesson 1.02).
Store both directions at the same time when you make a new mapping.
requirements: Outgoing: map each new (inside address, inside port) to the next free public port, starting at 40000; reuse an existing mapping.
Incoming: look the public port up and forward, or drop it.
stretch: Expire mappings that have not been used for 60 seconds of simulated time.
